title: Charles V to the Empress Isabella, Borgo San Donnino 17 May 1536 (AGS Estado leg. 496 ff. 270-274, DECODE R9957) and to Prince Philip, Cremona 19 June 1543 (AGS Estado leg. 59 ff. 10-14, DECODE R9952)

documents.route: Charles V (Borgo San Donnino) to the Empress Isabella of Portugal

plaintext.source: two interlinear glosses on p. 16 and a contemporary decipherment of the pp. 16-17 cipher on pp. 17-18; the whole letter printed by Luo (2021) p. 287

transcription.source: two subagents from DECODE images (trans_p1-9.txt, trans_p10-18.txt)
transcription.notes: First-pass transcription; glyph naming not unified and sign boundaries not matched to the syllable system, so no count is given.

plaintext.source: marginal decipherments ff. 10-12 and full decipherment ff. 13-14 ('del Emperador a Su Al.')

transcription.notes: Not transcribed: read at the time.

system.summary: R9957: the Isabella-Charles V cipher of 1535-38 (AGS Estado leg. 1.1.1 doc. 169, per Luo 2021 and Tomokiyo): homophonic letters, double letters, syllables as base sign plus vowel stroke or numbers 32-91, codes 92-211, nulls.
system.notes: System description taken from Tomokiyo's summary of Luo (2021), not rebuilt here. R9952 uses the Charles V-Prince Philip cipher (Tomokiyo).

prior_solution.where: R9957: Luo 2021 (thesis, Universitat de Valencia) p. 287, key AGS Estado leg. 1.1.1 doc. 169; partial contemporary decipherment on the leaves. R9952: contemporary marginal and separate decipherment; key matched by Tomokiyo (cryptiana).

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie to the model, set up Claude Code with Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: DECODE metadata for R9952/R9957 via the API; 38 images fetched with the shared cookie.
Viewed all pages: R9952 is a different letter (Cremona 1543), deciphered in the margins and on ff. 13-14.
Two subagents transcribed the R9957 cipher passages, pp. 1-9 and 10-18.
Found the contemporary decipherment of the pp. 16-17 cipher on pp. 17-18 and two interlinear glosses on p. 16; read the decipherment.
Hard-EM monotone aligner (from balbases1677) of the p. 16-17 tokens against the decipherment.
Tomokiyo cryptiana page (cached copy) lists R9957 as deciphered and printed in Luo 2021 p. 287, cipher AGS Estado leg. 1.1.1 doc. 169, and R9952 as deciphered in the margin.

outcome.method_basis: Nothing was read here: R9957 was deciphered and printed by Luo 2021 (p. 287, key AGS Estado leg. 1.1.1 doc. 169), found after a failed alignment attempt, and R9952 has a contemporary decipherment in the margins and on ff. 13-14.
outcome.notes: Nothing new read. Added: R9957 dated Borgo San Donnino 17 May 1536 (not Burgos, not 8 or 18 May); R9952 is a separate 1543 letter to Philip; DECODE image order. Catalogue entry 199 removed; no write-up.
